interpretation: Post-V9 exploratory mechanism study. No new confirmatory p-values or significance-driven expansion.

regional.masks: Original task mask; per-image sensitivity quartiles and depth-gradient top10%; distance <2,2-4,>=4m. No learned selection.
regional.scope: Validation weights are computed for post-hoc interpretation only, never used to train V9.

gradient.scope: Gradients on shared LoRA parameters, fixed training images. Cosine and norms are diagnostics, not causal proof.

noise.start: Fresh original Marigold plus new seed-matched rank4 LoRA, not a selected V9 checkpoint.
noise.labels: Both depth and derived sigma1 normals come from corrupted training depth. RGB always rendered from clean geometry.
noise.mask: Clean depth jump/erosion support and10px border fixed across corruptions/rules; differs intentionally from noisy-mask V8 component test.
noise.oracle: exp(-angular_error(noisy_sigma1_normal,analytic_clean_normal)/10); diagnostic privileged weight, not a deployable method or guaranteed upper bound.
noise.rule_scope: Only decoded geometry consistency is weighted. Supervised latent depth/normal objectives remain unweighted.
noise.evaluation: Clean analytic depth and normals; full480x640, identical fixed masks, no GT alignment; fixed final64step checkpoint.
noise.rendering: Lambertian shading plus fixed image-coordinate albedo and depth attenuation. Simplified synthetic domain, not photorealism.
noise.limitation: Only2training seeds and64updates. New generator seeds share the same surface families; no real-world generalization/convergence claim.
